race.description: Fowler Civil Contracting Pty Ltd F&M Mdn Plate
race.comment: LLANTARNAM (5) made an encouraging start to her career last time out over 1250m at Newcastle, boxing on well after racing in the leading division to finish a close third. Bred to want a bit of ground so 1400m at the second run looks ideal. Speedy mare KOIBITO (2) just failed to hang on first-up over 1250m at Newcastle then led for the judge over the mile at Warwick Farm last start but tired late. Nicely placed back to a 1400m provincial maiden. Looms as a serious threat. MICHONNE'S KATANA (6) caught the eye when fresh from a spell recently over 1250m at Newcastle, coming from near the tail to be beaten half a length. Will go back from a wide alley but watch for her in the concluding stages. BILLAPALOOLA (9) has found the line well at both runs this prep and is ready to peak now.
